title: Cloudflare Status - Cloudflare Secure Web Gateway and DLP enforcement issues for Google Gemini
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Cloudflare Secure Web Gateway and DLP enforcement issues for Google Gemini
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-19T20:30:00.915Z
Resolved: 2026-10-20T22:46:39.852Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-20T22:46:39.852Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-10-19T23:46:48.411Z: identified - We are rolling out a fix to restore Secure Web Gateway application controls for Google Gemini. Work continues to restore DLP prompt logging and enforcement.
- 2026-10-19T20:30:00.915Z: identified - Cloudflare has identified an issue affecting Gateway application controls and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) inspection for certain Google Gemini traffic.
We are working on a fix and will provide further updates as more information becomes available.

incident.name: Cloudflare Secure Web Gateway and DLP enforcement issues for Google Gemini

incident_updates.body: We are rolling out a fix to restore Secure Web Gateway application controls for Google Gemini. Work continues to restore DLP prompt logging and enforcement.

Cloudflare has identified an issue affecting Gateway application controls and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) inspection for certain Google Gemini traffic.
We are working on a fix and will provide further updates as more information becomes available.

affected_components.name: Cloudflare Sites and Services - Data Loss Prevention (DLP)

components.name: Gateway
components.description: Cloudflare’s secure web gateway keeps your data safe from malware, ransomware, phishing, command & control, Shadow IT, and other Internet risks over all ports and protocols. Log every user interaction with rich details.
